note: Ground truth for the fixture corpus. Kept outside fixtures/ on purpose: a scan reads its whole target, and a file listing the answers would turn detection into reading. Line numbers are where the flaw is expressed, not where it is reachable from.

flaws.summary: SQL query concatenated from the ?name= request parameter
subprocess with shell=True and the ?host= request parameter
strcpy into a 32-byte stack buffer from an unchecked argument
entry freed but left in the table, then read by a later lookup
bound uses > so index MAX_RECORDS is admitted, one past the last slot
path.join with an unvalidated ?name=, so ../ escapes the public root
server-side request to an arbitrary ?url=, reachable to internal addresses
admin token compared with === rather than a constant-time comparison

fixtures.name: clean-python
fixtures.why: Nothing is planted here. Parameterised queries, no shell, no user-controlled paths. Anything reported against this fixture is a false positive, and that number decides whether the tool is worth running.
